dispatch: operate(state, action, value) returns next state or throws; errors leave prior state unchanged.
origin: Floor at center of AVH-1000; glTF +Y up, +Z toward operator. Do not rescale for VR. Hit bounds are world metres in the closed/engaged pose; use live mesh transforms in other poses.
interaction: Select first visible target mesh or ancestor. Display cutaway and camera are not physical state. Hinge swings 80 degrees; coarse retract 10 mm, both illustrations. Head raster X/Z travel is physical nm, height follows simulated envelope; use magnified screen for inspection.
xr: Optional immersive-vr on supporting browsers. No physical Quest performance or accuracy validation.
